g.text: Voxtral: prompt content and language against no prompt

20-file corpus (17 Japanese, 3 English), M2 Ultra, 30s chunks, batch 32, kv8; topic and terms derived from the references (freq and names). No prompt is the default because every arm costs English 2.0 to 75.9 WER points and no arm resolves a Japanese gain; the best, -0.15, has a CI spanning zero. Source:
